aipconnect-aipconnect:lever:873d2268-920.description: Open Vacancy: This role is a current, active position and we are accepting applications. Company Overview Our client is an independent marketing consultancy specializing in market research, with expertise in storytelling through consumer and brand insights. They focus on key areas such as advertising effectiveness, sponsorship evaluation, and consumer behaviour analysis. By leveraging data-driven insights and strategic solutions, they help businesses and top-tier brands optimize marketing strategies and drive growth. The Role As a Consumer Insights Analyst, you will play a key role in a dynamic team, providing analytical support across a range of quantitative consumer research projects. You will analyze data, uncover meaningful insights, and help translate findings into recommendations that drive client growth and smarter business decisions. As part of a small and nimble team, you’ll gain exposure to a variety of clients, industries, and research initiatives - from sponsorship and event measurement to brand health studies, campaign testing, and broader brand strategy projects. Working across sectors such as financial services, entertainment, nonprofit, CPG, and sports, you’ll have the opportunity to build a well-rounded understanding of how consumer insights shape marketing strategies. This role is ideal for a motivated, driven, and self-directed professional who thrives in an entrepreneurial environment and values a fun, inspiring team culture.
responsibilities: Oversee project execution to ensure deliverables are completed accurately and on time.
Contribute to all stages of the research lifecycle, from design to insights delivery.
Analyze data in alignment with client objectives to uncover meaningful insights.
Develop clear, visually compelling reports that communicate key findings effectively.
Translate data into actionable insights and strategic recommendations that drive client impact.
Engage in broader business initiatives beyond daily responsibilities, fostering professional growth and development.
qualifications: College or university degree preferred, ideally in business or marketing, but not required.
1-2 years of experience in quantitative data analysis for a brand, company, or consumer research firm is ideal.
Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint is essential.
Experience with statistical programs (e.g., SPSS or SAS) is a plus, or a willingness to learn.
Strong commitment to continuous learning and professional development.
Confidence in your abilities—knowing you exceed the average, without arrogance.
Proficiency in English is required.

jobgether-jobgether:lever:3eedeada-c51e-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Software Engineer, Backend - Data Layer based in United Kingdom. As a Backend Software Engineer on the Data Layer team, you’ll help build and evolve the storage and query infrastructure behind a large-scale process orchestration platform. You’ll work across relational databases and Elasticsearch/OpenSearch to keep process data reliable, performant, and available. Your work will directly support capabilities ranging from process monitoring to emerging AI-driven automation experiences. You’ll tackle complex challenges around data storage, retention, streaming, secondary storage, and scalability. The role offers strong ownership, with opportunities to shape technical solutions from requirements through production delivery. You’ll collaborate closely with Product, QA, SRE, Support, and fellow engineers in a remote-first environment. It’s an opportunity to make a meaningful impact on a sophisticated backend platform while growing your expertise in data-intensive systems. Design, build, and maintain backend services responsible for storing and serving process data across relational databases and Elasticsearch/OpenSearch, with a strong focus on correctness, performance, reliability, and scalability. Own engineering initiatives end to end, translating product requirements into technical designs, breaking complex work into actionable tasks, and driving delivery to a high standard. Help evolve how process data is processed, retained, exposed, and streamed so customers can access and use their data effectively. Improve the performance and scalability of secondary storage systems as platform usage grows, while developing tooling that supports observability, troubleshooting, and safe production operations. Investigate and resolve complex data-layer production issues, including slow queries, indexing problems, and execution-plan challenges, as part of L3 support and on-call rotations. Partner with Product Management, Support, SRE, QA, and other engineering teams to ensure technical solutions meet customer needs and production requirements. Contribute to continuous improvement by bringing lessons from production incidents and customer feedback back into engineering practices and product development. Requirements: At least 4 years of professional experience as a Backend Software Engineer, with a strong focus on backend systems and production data stores. Hands-on experience with at least one major database or search technology such as PostgreSQL, MySQL, MariaDB, MSSQL, Elasticsearch, or OpenSearch. Practical understanding of query performance, indexing strategies, data modeling, execution plans, and the trade-offs involved in designing data-intensive systems. Demonstrated experience contributing to complex engineering initiatives, including requirements analysis, technical design, task decomposition, implementation, and reliable delivery. Ability to troubleshoot data-related production issues and investigate slow queries, index usage, and other performance bottlenecks. Strong communication and collaboration skills, particularly in a remote-first environment, with the ability to work effectively with Product and engineering stakeholders and provide and receive constructive code-review feedback. Willingness to use and understand the product as part of developing customer-focused solutions. Experience with workflow automation, process orchestration, or developer platforms is a plus. Experience working across both relational databases and Elasticsearch/OpenSearch is advantageous. Familiarity with CI pipelines and database migration or schema-evolution tools such as Liquibase or Flyway is beneficial. The role offers significant influence over brand visibility, credibility, awareness, and global expansion. You’ll work closely with senior leadership, Marketing, Product, and creator-focused teams in a highly dynamic and often ambiguous environment. It’s an exciting opportunity for a well-connected PR professional who knows how to turn emerging trends, products, and cultural moments into compelling stories. Respond quickly and strategically to breaking news, cultural moments, and opportunities that can increase awareness and credibility. Balance long-term brand building with short-term media opportunities that generate measurable awareness, traffic, and engagement. Contribute to the expansion of the organization's international media presence as it enters new markets. matchgroup-matchgroup:lever:ef27d211-c82.title: Senior Software Engineer, Backend — Seoul Studios (Tinder Seoul)
matchgroup-matchgroup:lever:ef27d211-c82.description: About the Team Seoul Studios is Tinder's Seoul-based product studio, chartered to build breakthrough innovations in how people meet and connect. We move fast — incubating new, interactive dating experiences, running rapid experiments, and shipping features that raise engagement and improve reconsideration for members around the world. Based in Seoul, the pod is a self-contained, cross-functional team of iOS, Android, web, and backend engineers working shoulder to shoulder with Product, Design, and Data, and partnering with teams across Seoul and our U.S. headquarters to take ideas from early experiment to global scale. About the Role As a Senior Backend Engineer on Seoul Studios, you'll design and build the scalable, low-latency backend systems that power new, interactive, and often real-time dating experiences. You'll own the architecture of complex services end to end, make sound tradeoffs across performance, reliability, and scalability, and help set the technical bar for a fast-moving pod. You'll partner closely with Product, Design, Data, and client engineers to ship high-quality features on a rapid cadence, and mentor fellow engineers as a senior member of the team. Where you'll work This is a hybrid role and requires in-office collaboration three times per week. Our office is located in Seoul.
responsibilities: Design, build, and operate scalable, low-latency backend services that power new, interactive, and real-time dating experiences.

Lead the technical design and architecture of complex backend systems and their integrations with core Tinder platforms, making sound tradeoffs across performance, reliability, and long-term scalability.
Build for a fast, experiment-driven cadence — enabling rapid iteration, A/B testing, and quick launches without compromising reliability.
Ensure service performance, reliability, and stability for live and real-time experiences under real-world traffic.
Partner with Product, Design, Data, and client (iOS/Android/web) engineers to deliver features end to end.
Drive engineering excellence — architecture, design, and code reviews, testing, and best practices — and help raise the technical bar across the pod.
Mentor fellow engineers and contribute to the pod's technical direction and decision-making.
Own features end to end, from design and implementation through deployment and operation.
qualifications: 5+ years of professional backend software development experience.
Proven experience designing and building low-latency, distributed backend systems at scale.
Proficiency with Java and/or Kotlin (Spring / WebFlux), or strong equivalent backend engineering experience.
Experience with relational and NoSQL databases (e.g., RDB, Redis, DynamoDB) and streaming/messaging systems such as Kafka.
Experience operating applications on Kubernetes and cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, or Azure).
Solid understanding of backend architecture and the judgment to know when and how to make tradeoffs; an advocate for code quality and sound engineering practices.
Ability to work autonomously and drive projects proactively, and to lead and mentor within a team.
Excellent communication skills and the ability to collaborate across functions, cultures, and global time zones.
Able to travel internationally without restriction.
Experience with real-time and low-latency systems (WebSocket, WebRTC, presence, live events, or media streaming).
Experience with high-scale data pipelines and streaming technologies (Kafka, Flink, Spark, ElasticSearch).
Experience building APIs that power mobile (iOS/Android) and web applications.
Experience with experimentation platforms and iterative A/B testing at scale.
Experience taking a product from 0→1 and operating in a fast-moving, startup-like pod within a larger organization.
Comfortable working with legacy code and implementing effective strategies for improvement.
BS/MS in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
Experience leveraging AI tools and the broader AI ecosystem to build and work more innovatively and productively.
Professional working proficiency in English (Seoul-based, global cross-timezone role).

southparkcommons-render:ashbyhq:d5f62097.title: Staff / Principal Product Manager, Platform & Infrastructure
southparkcommons-render:ashbyhq:d5f62097.description: At Render, we’re building the modern cloud platform for developers creating AI-native, full-stack, multi-service applications. Our mission is to eliminate the tradeoff between the power of hyperscalers and the simplicity of developer-friendly platforms—so teams can ship fast, scale reliably, and focus on their product, not infrastructure. Unlike complex hyperscalers or ephemeral edge/serverless solutions, Render offers a developer-first experience with persistent compute, dynamic autoscaling, built-in orchestration, and observability, allowing teams to launch, scale, and manage real-world applications without writing infrastructure code or managing servers. Whether you're building LLM-powered applications, scalable SaaS products, or async processing pipelines, Render empowers teams to move fast and scale confidently from MVP to millions of users. Our platform is trusted by over 7 million developers worldwide and continues to grow rapidly. In February 2026, we raised an additional $100M in Series C financing, bringing our total funding to $260M, to accelerate our vision of making cloud infrastructure both powerful and intuitive—designed for the speed of modern AI development. We’re a diverse and talented team that values craft, velocity, and user experience. If you’re excited to help shape the future of the intelligent cloud and empower developers everywhere, we’d love to hear from you. APPLYING TO RENDER We're seeking candidates who possess high integrity, humility, and an insatiable drive to learn. Through reasoned discussions and continuous feedback, we strive to improve both individually and collectively. We foster an environment of mutual trust and respect, empowering effective debate to achieve the best outcomes for our customers and team. We especially encourage members of underrepresented groups in the tech community to apply and understand that not all successful candidates will meet each requirement listed. Our interview process is unique to each role, and we value the candidate experience just as much as our customer experience. We hope your conversations with us reflect a thoughtful process that is illuminative, enjoyable, and respectful of your time. ABOUT THE ROLE We're looking for a Staff Product Manager to own the vision and roadmap for Render's infrastructure platform. This is a role for someone who wants to define what a modern cloud platform looks like in an era where AI is fundamentally changing how software gets built and run. You'll drive the technical and strategic direction for Render's core platform, working directly with infrastructure engineering to shape architectural decisions. You’ll engage with Render's customers and our product development teams to develop a deep understanding of their needs and build conviction about where the platform needs to go next. WHAT YOU'LL DO: - Own the vision, strategy, and roadmap for the the foundational primitives upon which everything at Render is built. Your scope spans compute & orchestration, network topology, traffic, and routing features, and data storage infrastructure.. - Drive prioritization across Render's platform investments, balancing the leverage of foundational capabilities against near-term product and business needs and being able to negotiate those tradeoffs. - Partner deeply with Engineering & other Product teams to shape the technical direction of Render's core infrastructure, ensuring architectural decisions optimize for long-term reliability, performance, and extensibility. You’ll own the base layer of our stack, so having the dexterity to understand the shape of our other Product investment areas is essential. - Develop a strong, opinionated point of view on how Render's platform primitives need to evolve to serve AI-native builders, from compute and orchestration to storage and runtime. - Set the standard for how product teams build on Render's platform, providing clear guidance, boundaries, and abstractions that make it easy for other produc
